runners_data.name: Scriabin

races.paceDynamic: Way Maker, Etretat and Scriabin will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three having confirmed front-running tendencies. This should create an honest pace that will test stamina reserves over the 2m trip on testing ground. The combination of sustained early pace and soft going conditions will likely set up the race for horses that can conserve energy early and produce late surges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay off the early pace and finish strongly when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too hard early and fade from 3 out
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop on soft ground will take its toll, with Way Maker, Etretat and Scriabin all vulnerable to being passed by closers. Hold-up horses like Lexington Wood and Sonyourastar can pick up the pieces with strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front three maintains the pace and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: Way Maker or Scriabin could prove tough to peg back if they get the fractions right and have enough left in reserve. Their early position advantage becomes decisive when the pace doesn't completely fall apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kibris can sit just behind the leaders and time his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old's prominent style allows him to avoid the worst of the early pace battle while staying close enough to strike. His proven form on similar ground gives him the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go too slow or make jumping errors early
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start race would turn this into a sprint finish where tactical position matters more than stamina. The most alert jockey on a handy horse could steal it from an unlikely position.

watchPoints.text: Way Maker and Etretat could set suicidal fractions if they clash for the lead from the start
Kibris needs to settle behind the front three rather than joining the early pace battle to maximize his chances
Lexington Wood's position turning for home will be crucial as he needs clear running room for his trademark late surge
Scriabin showed good recent form but jumping under pressure at pace will test his hurdles technique
The 5lb and 10lb claiming jockeys on Sonyourastar and Struth may struggle with tactical positioning decisions

races.name: DM Hall Surveyors Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Busty Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid form figures but needs the pace to collapse late over this trip to be effective.

runners_data.name: Largy Force
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with excellent soft ground record (2W12P from 14 runs) and peak form figures of 21212.

runners_data.name: Red Happy
runners_data.note: Front-running type with hat-trick form wearing blinkers, but 47-day break and George Bewley's modest strike rate raise questions.

runners_data.name: Ned Tanner
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner with topspeed rating advantage but inconsistent recent form and 10-year-old legs are concerns.

runners_data.name: Inis Oirr
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse partnered by inexperienced 10lb claimer Walkingshaw which adds tactical uncertainty to his chances.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Blizzard
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 72-day layoff for in-form Russell/Scudamore team but lacks recent race fitness.

races.paceDynamic: Red Happy emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner in this small field, likely to bowl along at a sustainable gallop without pressure from the start. With three prominent runners (Ned Tanner, Cosmic Blizzard) sitting close behind and three hold-up horses (Busty Boy, Largy Force, Inis Oirr) tracking, the pace should be honest but not destructive over this stamina-sapping 3m trip on soft ground. Red Happy's uncontested lead will allow him to dictate fractions, while the hold-up brigade will rely on the testing conditions and trip to bring the pace back to them in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours either the lone leader Red Happy if he can sustain his gallop, or the proven stayers among the hold-up horses who can produce their trademark late surge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Red Happy Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy jumps cleanly and faces no early pressure from prominent runners.
scenarios.body: His sustainable gallop and tactical advantage of an uncontested lead becomes decisive over this stamina-sapping trip. The hold-up horses struggle to peg back his advantage despite the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the testing 3m trip and soft ground takes its toll on the front-runner in the final half-mile.
scenarios.body: Largy Force or Busty Boy unleash their trademark finishing kicks as Red Happy's gallop falters, with their superior stamina reserves proving decisive. The prominent runners get caught between paces.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Ned Tanner or Cosmic Blizzard track Red Happy perfectly and pounce at the optimum moment.
scenarios.body: They get the best of both worlds - close enough to strike when Red Happy weakens but not having done the donkey work themselves. Their tactical positioning proves superior to the hold-up horses who have too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Red Happy makes jumping errors or fails to handle the testing ground conditions early.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear tempo, suiting the most adaptable prominent runners who can quicken the pace. Ned Tanner's experience becomes crucial in a slowly-run tactical battle.

watchPoints.text: Red Happy's jumping under pressure - any early mistakes will destroy his front-running advantage completely.
Largy Force's position turning for home - if Sean Bowen is still last with 4f to run, he faces an impossible task.
Walkingshaw's tactical decisions on Inis Oirr - the 10lb claimer must time his challenge perfectly or waste the horse's finishing kick.
Ned Tanner's travel through the race - at 10 years old he cannot afford to fight for position early.
Ground conditions deteriorating - any further softening will heavily favour the proven soft ground performers Largy Force and Red Happy.

runners_data.name: Bold Light

runners_data.name: Summergrounds
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse with strong recent placings, handles the going well but faces tactical disadvantage

runners_data.comment: Only win was over 2m on heavy; not at his best last 4 starts; looks stable second string
runners_data.spotlight: Only win was in a Chepstow novice on heavy in January 2025 (2m); not at his best last four starts but on a fair mark now; looks stable second string.

runners_data.name: Sun Art

runners_data.comment: Won in first-time tongue-tie at Ludlow (2m) in March 2025; runner-up latest; stamina 2m4f?
runners_data.spotlight: Won in first-time tongue-tie at Ludlow (2m, novice; good) in March 2025; placed in three of his five starts since, runner-up to the 13-8 favourite Wild Goose at Hereford (2m, good) four weeks ago; stamina not yet proven over 2m4f; possible.

runners_data.name: Moyganny Phil
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with course win on soft ground, Sean Bowen booking positive but 40-day break a concern

runners_data.name: Dalileo

runners_data.comment: 4-56, latest win over 3m here last July on 2nd run after a break; may come on for the run
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 4-56, latest win coming off this mark over 3m here last July (good) on second run after a break; hasn't been out since November; should come on for the run.

runners_data.name: Easy To Follow
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner to challenge Dubhain early, 112-day break major fitness concern for Murphy

runners_data.name: Follow Charlie
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fair recent form, needs strong pace to be effective from back of field

runners_data.name: Dubhain
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with tactical advantage, headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement

races.paceDynamic: Dubhain is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady gallop over this 2m4f trip on testing ground. Easy To Follow may try to track the leader prominently, but the rest are hold-up performers who will settle back in the field. With 8 of 9 runners having hold-up styles, Dubhain faces no early pressure and can control the tempo to his advantage. This race shape strongly favours the early leader and prominent racers, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground on the testing surface against an uncontested pace-setter.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dubhain Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Dubhain gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lone leader faces no early pressure and can quicken when it matters, leaving the hold-up brigade with too much to do on testing ground. Easy To Follow may grab second if tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the testing ground finds out Dubhain's stamina in the closing stages
scenarios.body: Bold Light and Summergrounds have the class to reel in a tiring leader, with their patient tactics paying off late. The race becomes a sprint finish between the best hold-up performers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Easy To Follow applies early pressure to Dubhain from the outset
scenarios.body: The front two go too hard early, setting up the race for a closer like Sun Art or Follow Charlie to strike late. Testing conditions help those who conserve energy longest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both Dubhain and Easy To Follow stop badly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The entire field comes back to the pack finishers, creating a messy scramble where any hold-up horse could prevail. Carismatic Soldier's recent struggles continue despite the tactical advantage.

watchPoints.text: Dubhain must be watched for early pace judgment - if he goes too slow, hold-up horses get closer
Easy To Follow's fitness after 112 days off - if sharp, could provide crucial early pressure on leader
Bold Light and Summergrounds settling positions early - need to be handy enough to strike on testing ground
Weather conditions before race - any further rain would emphasize front-runner advantage even more
Jockey instructions on hold-up horses - any sent prominently would disrupt the predicted tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Kado Sacree

runners_data.name: Kinbara Firstdraft

runners_data.name: Sauce Of Life

runners_data.name: Atlantic City

runners_data.comment: Made recent winning C&D handicap debut (from 5lb lower); stablemate of Kado Sacree.
runners_data.spotlight: Form figures since leaving Ciaran Murphy read 21; produced late to make winning handicap debut over C&D (good; 4-1, from 5lb lower) three weeks ago; James King retains the mount with Sean Bowen booked to ride stablemate Kado Sacree; contender.

runners_data.name: Wasdell Dundalk
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose style suits the likely race shape but 232-day break at age 11 makes fitness doubtful.

runners_data.name: Largy Meadow
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying headgear changes and bottom weight could be dangerous if getting tactical race to suit.

runners_data.name: Getaway Master
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent soft ground record but running off just one day's rest after disappointing recent form.
runners_data.comment: Modest recent efforts at Chepstow and Hexham; fair mark but best form is on soft/heavy.
runners_data.spotlight: No reason to recommend on strength of modest efforts this year at Chepstow and Hexham (twice); however, the handicapper has cut him some slack, and he sits just 1lb higher than when winning readily at Carlisle (2m4f, soft) last November; best form is on soft/heavy.

races.paceDynamic: Lets Mingle is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady tempo given the lack of early pressure. The prominent horses including Atlantic City, Kado Sacree, Annie Agnew and Sauce Of Life will track behind but won't force the pace early. This creates a tactical race where the hold-up horses Kinbara Firstdraft, Wasdell Dundalk, Largy Meadow and Getaway Master have time to get organized for a late challenge. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can capitalize on the modest early gallop and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lets Mingle sets a steady pace without pressure through the early stages.
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo allows the back markers to save energy and unleash powerful finishing kicks in the final quarter mile. Kinbara Firstdraft and Wasdell Dundalk can use their closing style to full advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly and kicks before the hold-up horses get organized.
scenarios.body: Atlantic City or Kado Sacree can exploit their ideal tactical position to strike in the final furlong before the closers arrive. Their prominent style gives them first jump on the field when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Lets Mingle gets an uncontested lead and finds extra when challenged.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Lets Mingle to conserve energy and respond when the closers arrive in the straight. His recent win gives him confidence to fight back when headed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely sedate and multiple horses finish in a bunch.
scenarios.body: The crawling tempo means stamina becomes less important than a sharp turn of foot in a sprint finish. Any horse with decent speed can win from any position in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Lets Mingle sets extremely slow fractions early which could set up a cavalry charge finish that favors any horse with a decent turn of foot.
Annie Agnew shows any signs of ring rustiness early given the 195-day layoff which would effectively remove her from calculations.
Atlantic City jumps and travels smoothly given his recent course and distance success makes him the form pick.
Kinbara Firstdraft gets caught too far back early as his hold-up style needs the race to unfold perfectly to be effective.
The pace through the first mile determines whether this becomes a stamina test or sprint finish in the final quarter mile.

races.name: Edinburgh Gin Seaside Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Double Oban
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should get ideal position tracking the leaders under an in-form jockey

runners_data.name: Just Dottie
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer facing tactical disadvantage in small field but has shown excellent recent form including a course win

runners_data.name: Pure Gold
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse whose style is compromised by the likely strong pace and limited cover available

runners_data.name: Oh Janey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from a long absence but has proven course form and the tactical style to suit this race shape

runners_data.name: Magnolia
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with cheekpieces fitted who needs everything to fall right but has the stamina for testing conditions

runners_data.name: Trust House
runners_data.note: Natural leader with recent wins who should dictate terms but must avoid getting into an early speed duel

runners_data.name: Castle Ivers
runners_data.note: Front runner resuming hurdles career after a bumper win, returning from 27 days off with strong recent course form
runners_data.comment: Useful bumper & maiden hurdle winner; tailed off on recent comeback run (h'cap debut).
runners_data.spotlight: Looked useful when winning a Wetherby bumper by 7l in March 2024; hurdles career off to a perfect start at Warwick (2m, good to soft) the following season, but absent for 18-plus months thereafter until reappearing at Ayr (4-1 favourite; tailed off) recently; now sits 2lb lower.

races.paceDynamic: Castle Ivers and Trust House will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, both natural front runners with proven tactical pace. The small field means limited cover for hold-up horses, while the soft ground will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. With Double Oban and Oh Janey likely to track the leaders prominently, this sets up as an honest end-to-end test. The combination of confirmed pace-setters and testing ground clearly favours prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Double Oban or Oh Janey can sit just behind the leading duo without getting embroiled in their battle
scenarios.body: The prominent position allows them to strike when the leaders tire, while avoiding the stamina-sapping kick required from further back on this testing ground. This tactical positioning proves decisive as hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Trust House can dictate terms and see off Castle Ivers' challenge without a gruelling early battle
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run on the field and maintains momentum, with the testing conditions preventing any serious late challenge from the hold-up brigade. Castle Ivers' recent Warwick success suggests he could also profit if surviving the early exchanges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or becomes stop-start due to the leaders marking each other too closely
scenarios.body: Just Dottie and Pure Gold get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with the reduced pace negating the ground disadvantage. The hold-up horses benefit from a tactical race that plays to their strengths rather than requiring a stamina test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Magnolia Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true staying test and Magnolia's stamina reserves prove superior
scenarios.body: The combination of soft ground and honest pace finds out the others' limitations, allowing Hammond's mare to grind past tired leaders. Her hold-up style requires the perfect storm of strong pace and stamina-sapping conditions.

watchPoints.text: Castle Ivers and Trust House must avoid a mutually destructive early battle that could set up the race for those tracking behind
Just Dottie and Pure Gold need the pace to collapse or become tactical to overcome their hold-up disadvantage in this small field
Double Oban's ability to secure the ideal prominent position without getting trapped wide around the bend will be crucial to his chances
Oh Janey returning after 195 days off may need the run despite his proven tactical style suiting the race shape
Magnolia requires the strongest possible gallop and testing ground conditions to bring her stamina advantages into play

races.name: Edinburgh Cannonball Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Carrigeen Castle
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with solid recent form but faces tactical disadvantage from the back against likely strong pace bias

runners_data.name: Traveling Soldier
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally placed behind likely leader, 192 days off but strong previous form suggests retains ability

runners_data.name: Sir Carnegie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent form but headgear and running style work against the probable race shape
runners_data.comment: Back to form when chasing home Inis Oirr over C&D (good) three weeks ago; sits 2lb higher.
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a double with win at Kelso (3m, good to soft; 11-4) last November; wasn't fluent - has been a theme - but bounced back to form in reapplied cheekpieces when chasing home Inis Oirr over C&D (good) three weeks ago; 2lb higher with James Bowen taking over in the saddle; likely candidate.

runners_data.name: Wings On Wheels
runners_data.note: Another hold-up type who needs pace to aim at, recent form patchy and style doesn't suit likely scenario

runners_data.name: Tanking Along
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with recent experience and Charlie Maggs' 3lb claim, perfectly positioned tactically for this field

runners_data.name: Uncle Al
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying bottom weight but trainer's poor recent record and early unseat last time raises reliability concerns
runners_data.comment: Won at Sedgefield in December but hasn't performed to the same level subsequently
runners_data.spotlight: Won off this mark in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Sedgefield in December but below par on his next three starts and he unseated early at Hexham 12 days ago; needs to get back on track.

races.paceDynamic: Tanking Along is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset with no early pressure expected. With Traveling Soldier likely to settle prominently behind and the other four all hold-up types, this creates a strong pace bias toward the leaders. The lack of early pace pressure means Tanking Along can control fractions and kick when ready, while the quartet of hold-up horses (Carrigeen Castle, Sir Carnegie, Wings On Wheels, Uncle Al) face the difficult task of making up ground against horses who've had first run. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along gets uncontested lead and moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Tanking Along dictates perfect fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges, while Traveling Soldier benefits from the forward position. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do against runners who've controlled the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and kick comes late
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows multiple hold-up horses to get competitive positions turning in, creating a sprint finish. Sir Carnegie and Carrigeen Castle's class tells in a bunched finish where their higher ratings prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Traveling Soldier tracks and times challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Traveling Soldier uses his prominent position to strike at the optimal moment when Tanking Along begins to tire, while still having enough margin over the closers. His strong recent form and Sean Bowen booking suggests confidence in this tactical approach.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Tanking Along goes too slow and gets swamped
scenarios.body: The fractions become pedestrian allowing all the hold-up horses to arrive with chances, creating chaos in the final furlong. Wings On Wheels or Uncle Al could emerge from the pack at big prices in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Tanking Along getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through first mile he'll be very hard to peg back
Traveling Soldier's fitness after 192-day break - any signs of rustiness could derail prominent-runner scenario
Sir Carnegie's jumping - spotlight mentions fluency issues and any mistakes from behind will be costly
The pace through the first circuit - if too steady it brings all the hold-up horses into contention
Uncle Al's confidence after unseating early last time - any signs of hesitancy at fences could end chances quickly
